column1: # tools/css/gen-compute-tables.py: how each shorthand of the pin is split into longhands and written back (css_shorthand.h). Columns, tab separated:
#   shorthand   kind (the enumerator of GTEXT_CSS_Shorthand_Kind without its prefix)   note
# BOX: one to four values distributed to the four sides in the order of the pin's longhands (the {1,4} rule of CSS 2). PAIR: one or two values; a missing
# second is the first. ANY: components in any order, each assigned to the longhand whose grammar accepts it, the rest reset to their initial values. LAYERS:
# comma separated layers, each split as ANY; the longhands are comma lists. COPY: every longhand takes the whole value. ALL: the CSS-wide keywords only.
# The other kinds are the shorthands that have an algorithm of their own. UNIMPLEMENTED: expansion is GTEXT_CSS_E_UNSUPPORTED naming the shorthand
# (never a guess). A shorthand of the pin that is not here, or here and not in the pin, fails the gate.
